sloka: सा बाष्पशोकाभिहता समीक्ष्य तौ भ्रातरौ देवसमप्रभावौ ।वितर्कयन्ती निधनं तयोः सा दुःखान्विता वाक्यमिदं जगाद ।। ६.४७.२३ ।।
transliteration: sā bāṣpaśokābhihatā samīkṣya tau bhrātarau devasamaprabhāvau ।vitarkayantī nidhanaṁ tayoḥ sā duḥkhānvitā vākyamidaṁ jagāda ।। 6.47.23 ।।

translations.english: Janaka's daughter of beautiful limbs and dark eyes, seeing her husband and Lakshmana, both powerful ones rolling, roared aloud.
